content: Parameter Settings. We empirically set optimal parameters based on a held-out validation set that contains 20% of the test data. These include the hyperparamters of the target model, those of our proposed probabilistic model, and the parameters used for training the target model. We explore MLP with 1, 2 and 3 hidden layers and apply a grid search in 32, 64, 128, 256, 512 for the dimension of the embeddings and that of the hidden layers. For the coefficient of expectation regularization, we follow BIBREF6 (BIBREF6) and set it to $\lambda =10 \times $ #labeled examples. For model training, we use the Adam BIBREF22 optimization algorithm for both models.
